subject: Proposal from refiner
body: Refine analysis for issue #3665 (corrected per feedback): supervision layer is silent on 7 livelocks and loud at healthy agents. Root cause: the #2270 detection plane is fully implemented but completely unwired — snapshot_from_health_context() populates only 5 of 13 snapshot fields (snapshot_id, pipeline_id, phase, running_agents, phase_state), and _run_overseer_detection_plane() has zero call sites (the import in __init__.py:1277 is not a call site). The 2-hour ClaudeConfig.timeout kills agents with exit code -1, classified as abnormal by _classify_exit() at kubernetes_monitor.py:1148. Repetition loops are not detected because no deterministic unique-tool-input counter exists. Proposed work across 4 areas: (1) populate snapshot fields and wire detection plane into RUNTIME_TICK, (2) surface timeout to agents and classify timeout-kills distinctly, (3) implement deterministic loop detector, (4) enrich alert payloads and fix false positives. Ranked candidate list of 30 items with file-and-symbol citations and present/absent verdicts.

attestation.no_decisions_rationale: This refine phase produces an analysis artifact, not a code change. No HITL decisions are required — the four areas and the candidate list are the deliverable, and the gate (plan phase) will decide what to build.

candidates_considered.question: Should the detection plane replace the HealthMonitor tripwires?
candidates_considered.why: HealthMonitor tripwires ARE wired into the kubernetes_monitor RUNTIME_TICK path and working. The detection plane should complement them, not replace them. Replacing would create a gap during the transition.

candidates_considered.question: Should the 2-hour timeout be shortened?
candidates_considered.why: 7200s is a reasonable budget for long-running agent work. The fix is to make it visible to the agent and to classify timeout-kills distinctly, not to shorten the budget.

candidates_considered.question: Should LLM classification be added to the hot path?
candidates_considered.why: classify_stall() and classify_activity_pattern() use Haiku calls which are expensive. They belong in the overseer agent, not in the deterministic detection plane which must be LLM-free for the routine majority.

payload.risk_considered: The detection plane wiring is a new code path on the hot loop; must be exception-isolated and gated behind the existing HealthCheckRunner. The timeout classification change could mask real crashes if exit code -1 is used for other failures. The unique-tool-input counter depends on midturn_messages being populated, which requires snapshot enrichment.

subject: Re-sending: detect_heartbeat_stall answered. Emit your verdict.
body:
Operator. You asked this exact question in your previous session and I answered it there; that
context did not carry into this one, so here it is again. You are repeating
`grep -rn "detect_heartbeat_stall\|heartbeat_stall" orchestrator/health_checks/ ...` — 40
identical calls. Do not re-issue it.

**The verified answer, against `cf0e5a6fa`:**

`detect_heartbeat_stall` is defined at `orchestrator/health_checks/tier1/consensus_stall.py:217`
and has **zero non-def, non-test references anywhere in `orchestrator/`**. Your grep result is
correct and complete. It is unregistered because it is a bare coverage-gap detector reachable only
via `plane.evaluate(snapshot)`, and both `evaluate` call sites sit inside functions that are never
called — `_run_overseer_detection_plane` (`routes/pipelines/_overseer.py:309`) and
`HealthCheckRunner.run_detection_plane` (`health_checks/runner.py:159`). The sole production
reference to the former is the re-export at `routes/pipelines/__init__.py:1277`, which is an
import, not a call site.

Watch the trap in that same module: `consensus_stall.py` also defines a **registered**
`ConsensusStallCheck` class that *does* run on every runtime tick. Same file, two layers, opposite
fates.

**You have already completed your review.** Your own last message confirms all four gate items
were addressed — field count corrected to 5 of 13, and you were working through the rest. That is
the verdict. Emit it.

**Call `mcp__brc__ack` or `mcp__brc__nack` now.** You have made 363 tool calls, 165 distinct, 4
`mcp__*`. You are the only agent blocking refine consensus. This phase has been running 1h55m and
the gate feedback explicitly told the refiner not to re-derive the artifact; a further verification
pass by you is out of role for a revision round scoped to four named fixes.

If any single claim is still unverified, write "unverified: <claim>" in the verdict body and ACK or
NACK on the rest. Do not block on it.
